Romania's NATO territory hit by debris — first physical property damage (electricity pole, annex in Galati). RAF Typhoon shot down 1 Russian UAV near Romanian-Ukrainian border: first NATO aircraft kill of a Russian drone.

label: Russian overnight strikes — Odesa Oblast and Kharkiv infrastructure

notes: Overnight attack continuing Russia's sustained attritional campaign. Confirmed by Kyiv Independent and Ukrinform.

label: Russian missile — Kryvyi Rih industrial infrastructure

label: Russia 524 Shaheds + 22 missiles — Dnipro residential building struck, 20 injured
damage: 24-storey residential building struck in Dnipro; 18 injured including 2 children. Odesa districts hit: lecture hall and kindergarten damaged; 2 injured. 34 total locations hit across Ukraine by 18 missiles and 16 drones that broke through.
notes: 22 missiles also launched (14 ballistic); 4 missiles intercepted. Confirmed by Governors Hanzha (Dnipropetrovsk) and Lysak (Odesa). Source: Kyiv Independent, Al Jazeera.

label: Ukraine ~600-drone strike — Angstrem semiconductor plant Zelenograd, Kapotnya refinery, Moscow (200+ flights disrupted)
damage: Angstrem semiconductor plant (microelectronics for weapons) struck in Zelenograd; Kapotnya oil refinery; Solnechnogorsk oil pumping station; 120+ drones on Moscow region. 200+ Sheremetyevo Airport flights delayed/cancelled. 4 killed (3 Moscow region, 1 Belgorod), 17 injured.
notes: One of Ukraine's largest drone attacks of the war. Drones flew 500+ km inside Russia. Russia reported 1,000+ total drones intercepted across all directions in 24 hrs. Confirmed by CGTN, France 24, Newsweek.

label: Russian Shahed drone strikes Chinese cargo ship KSL Deyang — Black Sea near Pivdennyi port
damage: Chinese-owned KSL Deyang (Marshall Islands flag, all-Chinese crew) partially charred on one hull side; no casualties; vessel continued to destination. Caused diplomatic embarrassment for Russia 1 day before Putin's Beijing visit to Xi Jinping.
notes: Zelensky: 'Russians could not have been unaware of what vessel was at sea.' Russia did not comment. Most significant direct Russian action against a Chinese asset in the war. Confirmed by Al Jazeera.

label: Russia 209 Shaheds overnight — Izmail warehouse hit, Kherson injured (180/209 intercepted)
damage: Warehouse in Izmail district (Odesa Oblast) struck; man injured in Kherson Korabelnyi district. 86% interception rate maintained.
notes: Part of Russia's sustained near-nightly drone campaign. Smaller in scale than the May 18 barrage (524 drones) but continuing pressure on Ukrainian air defenses. Day 1,545.

label: Ukrainian Navy destroys Russian Ka-27 helicopter — Black Sea
damage: Russian Ka-27 anti-submarine helicopter destroyed over the Black Sea — continues Ukraine's campaign to degrade Russian naval aviation assets.
notes: Confirmed by Ukrainian MoD. Ka-27 is used for anti-submarine warfare and ship-based operations. Specific weapon type not confirmed.

label: Russia 154 Shaheds + 1 ballistic missile — overnight May 19–20
damage: Sustained pressure on Ukrainian air defenses; continued Day 1,546 aerial campaign pattern
notes: 154 Shahed-type drones plus 1 ballistic missile overnight May 19-20. Part of Russia's near-nightly barrage campaign in May 2026. Ukraine air defense worked to intercept across multiple oblasts.

label: Russia 116 Shaheds overnight May 20–21 — 109/116 intercepted (94%)
damage: 94% interception rate; limited damage. Ukraine air defenses performing at high sustained operational tempo throughout May 2026.
notes: Smallest overnight barrage in recent May 2026 pattern. Ukraine intercepted 109 of 116 drones — 94% rate among highest of the war.

label: Ukrainian long-range drones — oil refinery deep strike 1,500 km inside Russia
damage: Large fires with thick black smoke at Russian oil refinery; one of deepest penetration strikes of 2026 campaign. Zelensky confirmed the strike.
notes: Strikes now reaching 1,500 km (900 miles) into Russian territory. Part of Ukraine's sustained 2026 refinery campaign targeting Russia's fuel supply chains and energy export revenue.

label: Ukraine Operation 'Snow for Akhmat' — Chechen drone pilot academy, Snizhne (65+ killed)
damage: 2,484 sq-meter Sever-Akhmat drone training complex destroyed; 65 cadets and their commanding officer Lt. Col. 'Buryi' killed; explosives storage and command post eliminated.
notes: Operation 'Snow for Akhmat' — Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces + SBU; simultaneous with FSB HQ and air defense strikes. Combined: ~100 Russian personnel killed/wounded. Zelensky confirmed.

label: Russian overnight drone/missile barrage — Ukraine (5 killed, 41 injured, May 21–22)
damage: 5 civilians killed, 41 injured across multiple Ukrainian oblasts; residential areas and infrastructure targeted.

label: Ukrainian drones — Sheskharis oil terminal + Grushovaya depot + tanker 'Chrysalis', Novorossiysk
damage: Sheskharis oil terminal and Grushovaya oil depot ablaze; shadow-fleet tanker 'Chrysalis' struck; 2 wounded. Novorossiysk handles ~20% of Russia's crude exports (~75M tons/year).
notes: Ukraine's General Staff confirmed. Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Fortune confirmed fires at both oil facilities. Part of Ukraine's sustained campaign against Russian Black Sea energy infrastructure. Sheskharis is Russia's largest Black Sea crude oil export terminal.

label: Russia 600 drones + 90 missiles — largest attack on Kyiv since 2022 (549 drones + 55 missiles intercepted)
damage: 51 drones and 16 missiles struck 54 locations; 1–2 killed, 77–83 injured; National Chernobyl Museum nearly completely destroyed; National Philharmonic, Music Academy, National Library, Kyiv Opera, Contract House, Post Office, Ukrainian House damaged. Children's rehabilitation center also hit.
platform: Shahed/Geran drones + Kh-101 cruise missiles + Iskander-M ballistic
notes: Largest single aerial attack on Kyiv since the 2022 invasion. Putin framed as retaliation for Starobilsk. 604 of 690 projectiles intercepted. Zelensky warned attack was imminent hours before, citing US and European intelligence.

label: Russia fires Oreshnik IRBM — Bila Tserkva, Kyiv Oblast (first IRBM strike on Kyiv Oblast)
damage: Bila Tserkva (city of ~200,000; 64 km from Kyiv) struck by RS-26 Rubizh 'Oreshnik' intermediate-range ballistic missile — first confirmed Oreshnik strike on Kyiv Oblast. Near-impossible to intercept with existing systems.
notes: First Oreshnik strike on Kyiv Oblast. Oreshnik travels at hypersonic speed and can carry nuclear warheads. Ukraine's Patriot/SAMP-T cannot reliably intercept. Confirmed by Kyiv Independent, NPR, CNBC, Euromaidan Press.

label: Russian ballistic missile — Dnipro medical clinic (2 killed, 30+ injured incl. children)
damage: Medical clinic in Dnipro struck; 2 killed, 30+ injured including boys aged 3 and 6. Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk Oblast): separate drone struck 5-story residential building — 5 killed including a child. Part of broader 17-missile/31-drone May 25 wave.
notes: Ukraine air defenses shot down 17 missiles and 31 drones in May 25 wave; 246 of 262 total drones from May 24–25 combined wave neutralized. Day 1,551.

label: Russian kamikaze drones — Kharkiv oil depot struck twice, 18 injured across region
damage: Kharkiv oil depot struck twice by Shahed-type drones; 18 people injured across Kharkiv region including a 5-year-old child; Derhachi also struck by missile; 21 settlements in Kharkiv region attacked on May 25.

label: Russia repurposes S-300 as ground-attack missile — Donetsk dam floodgates, Vovcha River (6 homes flooded)
damage: S-300 anti-aircraft missile fired in ground-attack role struck floodgates of Vovcha River hydroelectric dam in Donetsk Oblast; 6 homes flooded; 26 civilians evacuated from Halytsynivka, Zhelanne-1, Zhelanne-2.
notes: Russia increasingly repurposes depleted S-300 SAM stockpiles as ground-attack munitions — low accuracy but available in quantity. Dam infrastructure targeting risks larger downstream flooding.

label: Russia 2 ballistic + 122 Shahed drones — Kyiv market destroyed, 4 killed; Mykolaiv high-rises hit
damage: One of Kyiv's oldest market complexes destroyed by fire; subway station shelter damaged; 4 killed, dozens wounded in Kyiv. Mykolaiv administrative building and 2 high-rise residential buildings damaged. Sumy region (Romny) also struck — 3 injured.
notes: Third successive night of large-scale attacks; part of Russia's sustained aerial campaign following the May 23–24 mass barrage and Oreshnik IRBM strike.

label: Ukrainian long-range drones — Voronezh military airfield (explosions, fires)
damage: Explosions and fires reported at Voronezh military airfield; ~600 km from Ukrainian border. Consistent with Ukraine's 2026 campaign targeting Russian air assets and logistics staging areas used to support the frontline.

label: Russian MLRS — Kherson Korabelnyi district playground (father killed, 3-year-old critical)
damage: Father killed; wife and two daughters (ages 3 and 6) wounded — 3-year-old in critical condition with blast injuries and shrapnel wounds to head, torso, limbs. Kherson's Korabelnyi district struck in daylight.
notes: Russia holds east bank of Dnipro River opposite Kherson; MLRS strikes on the liberated city are a near-daily occurrence. Targeting of populated playground in daylight drew international condemnation.

label: Ukrainian long-range drones — Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery ablaze (354 km from border)
damage: Lukoil-Volgograd refinery set on fire overnight; one of Russia's largest, processing ~11M tons/year. Strike part of Ukraine's sustained campaign against Russian oil infrastructure funding the war economy.
notes: Ukraine SBU confirmed strike. Follows Vtorovo (May 24), Kirishi (May 5), and multiple other refinery strikes in 2026. Volgograd is ~354 km from Ukrainian border. Zelensky approved new June long-range operation plans targeting Russian energy infrastructure.

label: Ukrainian drones — Taganrog airfield: 2× Tu-142 aircraft + Iskander-M destroyed
damage: Two Tu-142 long-range maritime patrol/anti-submarine aircraft and one Iskander-M tactical ballistic missile system destroyed at Taganrog military airfield, Rostov Oblast. No active Tu-142 production line — each loss operationally irreplaceable for Russian Naval Aviation.
notes: Confirmed by Major Robert 'Madyar' Brovdi, 1st Separate Unmanned Systems Center. Video footage released. Third major strike on Taganrog area in 2026 (Neptune missile strike on Atlant Aero factory: April 2026; drone strike with civilian casualties: March 31, 2026).

label: Ukrainian long-range drones — Armavir oil depot ablaze, Krasnodar Krai (~500 km from border)
damage: Oil depot in Armavir, Krasnodar Krai set ablaze; Zelensky confirmed strike. Simultaneous with shadow-fleet tanker hit in Taganrog port and marine oil terminal strike in occupied Crimea.
notes: Part of Ukraine's 2026 deep-strike energy campaign spanning Krasnodar Krai, Volgograd, Vladimir, Moscow, Ryazan, Leningrad, and Yaroslavl oblasts. Confirmed by Zelensky statement and Washington Times.

label: Russia 291 combat attacks + 277 guided aerial bombs + 8,549 drones — Ukraine-wide (Day 1,556)
damage: 291 total combat engagements: 91 airstrikes, 277 KABs, 8,549 kamikaze drones, 53 MLRS attacks across Ukraine. Pokrovsk and Huliaipole sectors heaviest. 18 settlements struck in Kharkiv Oblast (2 killed, 4 injured). Zaporizhzhia Oblast: 976 attacks on 55 settlements (2 killed, 7 injured). Locomotive engineer killed by drone on Zaporizhzhia railway.
casualties: Multiple killed and injured across Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia oblasts
notes: 291 combat attacks on May 30 (Day 1,556) exceeds May 29's 267 — escalating pace. Russia eliminated ~1,430 additional personnel. Ukrainian MoD reports cumulative losses reach ~1,362,500 total since Feb 24, 2022.

label: Russian drone — Shostka railway station destroyed, Sumy Oblast
damage: Railway station building in Shostka, Sumy Oblast destroyed; surrounding railway infrastructure damaged. Shostka is ~40 km from the Russian border.
notes: Part of Russia's systematic campaign targeting Ukrainian rail logistics. Shostka has been repeatedly struck by cross-border Russian attacks in 2025-2026.

label: Russian drone — Zaporizhzhia railway; locomotive engineer killed
damage: Russian drone struck a working locomotive on the Zaporizhzhia regional railway network, killing the locomotive engineer. Both electric and diesel locomotives reported struck. 976 total Russian attacks on 55 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast in 24 hours (2 killed, 7 injured total).
notes: Targeting of working civilian transport personnel represents intentional strike on civilian workers under international humanitarian law.

label: Russia continues fresh strike waves — Kyiv on high alert for 'systemic' bombardment (Day 1,557)
damage: Continued Russian strikes across Ukraine on May 31; Kyiv maintained emergency air defense posture after Russian Foreign Ministry signaled 'systemic strikes.' 232 combat engagements recorded since start of day. Taganrog port and Armavir oil depot fires from previous-day Ukrainian strikes confirmed still burning.
notes: 232 combat engagements by mid-day May 31 (Ukrinform). Kyiv under threat of 'systemic bombardment' per Russian FM warning. Zelensky sent urgent letter to White House on air defense interceptor shortages.

label: Russian drones — Kharkiv 2 districts struck; garages and vehicles on fire (June 1)
damage: Two districts of Kharkiv struck by Russian drones; garages and vehicles on fire; casualties reported

label: Russian drone — Odesa residential building (2 floors destroyed; fire; 1+ injured)
damage: Two floors of residential building in Odesa partially destroyed by drone strike; fire broke out; at least 1 person injured

label: Ukrainian long-range drones — 229 overnight (May 31→Jun 1): Saratov refinery ablaze, Kirov pipeline hit
damage: Rosneft Saratov refinery ablaze (~7M ton/year; 700km from front); Lazarevo pumping station Kirov region struck (serves Surgut-Gorky-Polotsk pipeline; ~1,300km from Ukraine); Belgorod, Voronezh, Rostov regions also hit; 3 injured in Belgorod
notes: Russia claimed 216 drones downed; Ukraine air force reported 212 intercepted. Two new Russian regions (Saratov, Kirov) hit in single night. Ukraine USF struck 18 Russian oil facilities throughout May 2026.

label: Russia mass strike — 73 missiles (8 Zircon) + 656 Shaheds → Kyiv; building collapse; 6 killed (Jun 2)
damage: Kyiv: 9-story residential building in Podilskyi district partially collapsed; fires in 7 city districts; citywide power outages. 6 killed + 63–65 wounded in Kyiv. Dnipro: 4+ killed, 16 wounded. Kharkiv: 10 wounded incl. 1 child. Zaporizhzhia, Poltava, Khmelnytskyi, Sumy regions also struck.
casualties: 17–18 killed, 100+ wounded nationwide; 6 killed + 63–65 wounded in Kyiv
notes: Largest combined missile + drone attack since May 23, 2026 (600 drones + 90 missiles). 8 Zircon hypersonic missiles — largest single-use of Zircon in the war. 656 Shaheds launched; 602 intercepted.

label: Russia 656-Shahed drone swarm — Kyiv, Dnipro, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia (Jun 2)
damage: Shahed drone wave covering multiple Ukrainian oblasts; Kyiv Podilskyi district residential building collapse (people trapped); 7 city districts on fire; power outages across multiple regions
casualties: Part of combined attack killing 17–18 nationwide
notes: Russia's largest single-night drone barrage since May 2026 escalation began. Combined with 73 missiles, this is the largest simultaneous missile+drone attack of June 2026.

label: Ukrainian drones — Ilsky oil refinery, Krasnodar (16th strike of war)
damage: Large fire at Ilsky refinery (~6.6M ton/year capacity) visible 10+ km away; 16th Ukrainian strike on this facility since February 2022. Pantsir-S1 air defense system also destroyed. Russian vessel struck in occupied Crimea.
notes: Part of Ukraine's sustained 2026 energy infrastructure campaign. Ukraine also destroyed a Pantsir-S1 air defense system and struck a Russian vessel in Crimea in the same operational window.

label: Ukrainian drones — St. Petersburg oil terminal + corvette Boikiy, Kronstadt (SPIEF day 1)
damage: St. Petersburg oil terminal set ablaze — one of Russia's largest NW oil transshipment complexes. Guided-missile corvette Boikiy struck in dry dock at Kronstadt naval base — first confirmed strike on Russian naval vessel in Gulf of Finland. Weapons plant hit in Tambov (~600 km from border); infrastructure struck in Smolensk. Several wounded in St. Petersburg.
notes: Timed to coincide with opening day of St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF — 'Russia's Davos'). Russia claimed 354 drones intercepted overnight. One of the largest single Ukrainian drone operations of 2026.

label: Russian drone — Kharkiv multi-story residential building (two districts hit)
damage: Multi-story residential building struck, causing fire; two districts of Kharkiv targeted. Part of sustained daily Russian drone/bomb campaign against Ukraine's second-largest city.

label: Ukrainian drones — Svetlyak-class patrol ship, occupied Crimea (+ gunpowder plant inside Russia)
damage: Svetlyak-class border patrol ship struck in occupied Crimea; gunpowder plant and military storage facilities struck inside Russian territory. Part of Ukraine's sustained June 2026 deep-strike operations.

label: Ukrainian drones — Novocherkassk Thermal Power Plant, Rostov Oblast (regional blackout)
damage: Novocherkassk Thermal Power Plant (2,112 MW capacity) struck; regional power outage in Rostov Oblast. Part of Ukraine's campaign against Russian energy generation infrastructure.

label: Russian strike — Odesa energy infrastructure (33,500 without power)
damage: Energy infrastructure in Odesa Oblast struck; 33,500 consumers left without electricity. Continued Russian attritional campaign against Ukraine's southern power grid.

label: Ukrainian drones — 3 Lukoil Caspian Sea oil rigs (unprecedented offshore strike)
damage: Three Lukoil offshore oil drilling rigs in the Caspian Sea struck — unprecedented strike on Russia's offshore oil production infrastructure. Demonstrates Ukraine's long-range drone program reaching targets hundreds of km beyond Russian land territory.
notes: Caspian Sea rigs are ~1,300–1,500 km from Ukrainian-controlled territory — among the most distant Ukrainian drone strikes of the war.

label: Russian 272-drone overnight attack — 249 intercepted by Ukraine Air Force
damage: 2 killed in Zaporizhzhia region; 1 killed, 3 wounded in Dnipropetrovsk; 2 civilian maritime vessels attacked. 46 air strikes (134 guided bombs) also conducted; 2,445 artillery shells fired. 183 combat engagements recorded along frontline.
notes: Ukraine's Air Force intercepted 249 of 272 drones (~91.5% interception rate). Simultaneous with Ukraine's second large-scale drone strike on St. Petersburg/Kronstadt.

label: Ukrainian drones — St. Petersburg / Kronstadt (2nd strike; SPIEF closing day; 376 claimed intercepted)
damage: Kronstadt naval base, oil complex, and naval facilities struck for second time in 4 days. Large fires reported. Krasnodar region oil depot also struck (~500km from Ukraine). Russian governor Beglov: 86 drones in Leningrad region alone. St. Petersburg residents told to stay indoors.
notes: Second Ukrainian drone strike on St. Petersburg in one week — the first (June 3) targeted SPIEF opening day; this strike targeted SPIEF closing day with ~20,000 guests from 130+ countries still present. Ukraine's 2026 drone campaign had by this point struck 174 Russian air defense systems at an estimated cost of $5.4B to Moscow.

label: Ukraine strike — Nizhnekamsk oil refinery (Tatarstan)
notes: Third Ukrainian strike on this refinery complex in 2026, ~800km east of Moscow

label: Russia strike — Zaporizhzhia (North Korean KN-23 + Zircon)
casualties: 6 killed, 19+ wounded in Zaporizhzhia; 12+ killed nationwide
platform: KN-23 ballistic missile / Zircon cruise missile / guided aerial bombs
notes: Same nationwide barrage damaged Kyiv children's hospital grounds (no casualties there) and killed civilians in Dnipropetrovsk and Donetsk regions

label: Ukraine strike — Voronezh Wildberries hub + Orenburg refinery
notes: Also struck Orsknefteorgsintez oil refinery in Orenburg region, ~1,500km from Ukraine border

label: Ukraine strike — Novorossiysk naval base (15-weapon combined strike)
damage: 2 frigates (incl. Admiral Makarov), large landing ship, corvette damaged; 2 grain terminals disabled
platform: Palianytsia jet drone / Neptune cruise missile / naval drone
notes: Zelensky called it a coordinated nighttime operation; water service to 260,000+ residents cut, state of emergency declared

label: Russia strike — Odesa port (fuel depot, tanker, cargo ship)
casualties: 8 killed, 57 injured nationwide (incl. 2 killed in Odesa oblast tanker-truck strike)
platform: Iskander-M ballistic missile / Kh-31P anti-radiation missile / Kh-35 cruise missile / Shahed-type drones
notes: Part of a nine-region nationwide barrage; Russia claimed 502 Ukrainian drones intercepted the same night

label: Russia strike — Odesa–Dnipro passenger train (Berezivka)
casualties: 2 railway workers killed (driver + assistant); 340 passengers evacuated safely
notes: Monitoring team stopped train before impact but crew had no time to evacuate

label: Ukraine strike — Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat refinery (Bashkortostan)
platform: long-range attack drone (1st Separate Center, Unmanned Systems Forces)
notes: Second strike on this refinery in a month (after July 14, 2026); ~1,300km from Ukraine border; refinery processes ~7.2M tons/year

label: Russian jet-powered drones — Buryn, Sumy region (2 killed)
damage: Private residence destroyed by fire; 2 killed (29-year-old woman and her 9-year-old son), 4 injured with severe burns

label: Russian guided aerial bombs — Kramatorsk & Bilenke apartment block
damage: Apartment block hit; fire spread through multiple floors; 1 killed, 15-18 injured
notes: 8 guided aerial bombs (reported as FAB-250s) struck Kramatorsk and Bilenke village between 20:30-20:56 local time

label: Ukrainian drones — Ust-Luga Baltic oil port (54-drone strike, 6th of 2026)
damage: Two processing plants damaged; fire extinguished within hours
notes: At least the 6th Ukrainian strike on Ust-Luga in 2026; part of sustained campaign against Russian Baltic oil export infrastructure

label: Ukraine Flamingo cruise missiles — Savasleyka airbase (MiG-31K Kinzhal carriers)
damage: Fires reported at airbase hosting MiG-31K jets equipped with Kh-47M2 Kinzhal hypersonic missiles
notes: ~700km from Ukraine border; confirmed by Ukraine's General Staff

label: Ukraine Flamingo cruise missiles — Progress Rocket and Space Center, Samara
damage: Explosion and fire at Roscosmos facility manufacturing Soyuz-2 rockets and weapons electronics
notes: ~900km from Ukraine border, per Zelensky confirmation; part of Ukraine's 'long-range sanctions' campaign

label: Russian drones — Zaporizhzhia gardening community (2 killed)
damage: Gardening community struck, fire broke out; separate drone hit a bread delivery vehicle near Bilenke village
notes: Part of 1,158 Russian attacks on 59 Zaporizhzhia settlements in the preceding 24 hours

label: Ukrainian rockets — Koloskovo village, Belgorod region (6 killed)
damage: Structure burned, vehicle damaged in Koloskovo village, ~24km from Ukraine border
notes: Acting Belgorod Governor Alexander Shuvaev reported the strike; separate Ukrainian drone strike killed 1 in Astrakhan region same day

label: Russian Banderol missiles — Pechenihy, Kharkiv region (10 killed)
damage: 10 private homes, a cafe, post office, store, and 7+ vehicles damaged or destroyed at a residential intersection
casualties: 10 killed, 18+ injured in Pechenihy; 5 injured (incl. 9-year-old) in nearby Izyum
notes: Part of a 147-drone overnight barrage on Ukraine (111 intercepted); Russian drones also struck Brovary, Kyiv region, damaging an office building and warehouses

label: Ukrainian drones — Moscow region (620+ drone barrage)
damage: Wildberries logistics warehouse hit again (billions of rubles in losses reported); residential building fire in Pavlovsky Posad; chemical plant, shopping center, and other facilities damaged across Moscow Oblast
notes: Moscow Mayor Sobyanin reported 180 drones downed over Moscow Oblast; Russia's Defense Ministry claimed 791 downed across 13 regions; TASS called it the largest drone attack on Moscow in two years

label: Russian drone strike — Kherson city bus (4 killed)
damage: Bus and car struck in separate drone attacks in Kherson city
casualties: 5 killed (4 in bus strike, 1 in car strike), 5 injured
notes: Part of a wider wave of drone strikes killing 6 across Ukraine on Aug 19, including a separate strike in Zaporizhzhia (1 killed, 7 injured)

label: Ukrainian drones — Sverdlov explosives plant, Dzerzhinsk (Nizhny Novgorod region)
damage: Large fire at century-old explosives plant sanctioned by US/UK/EU/Japan/Switzerland; previously struck Apr 30, 2026
notes: ~470km from Ukraine border

label: Russian ballistic/cruise missile & drone barrage — Kyiv (15+ killed)
damage: 9-storey residential building partially collapsed and caught fire in Solomianskyi district; children's hospital damaged; 28 locations struck across the city
platform: Kinzhal, Banderol, cruise missiles, jet-powered drones
notes: Zelensky called it 'a massive attack' combining multiple missile types

label: Russian double-tap drone strike — Solnechnaya Galereya mall, Kryvyi Rih (16 killed)
damage: Solnechnaya Galereya shopping mall heavily damaged; second drone hit same site ~30 min later, targeting first responders
casualties: At least 16 killed, 130+ injured (23 children), 9 missing
notes: Zelensky's hometown; Ukrainian officials call it a 'double-tap' attack targeting rescuers

label: Russian Shahed strike — Tokarivka, Mykolaiv region (4 killed incl. 3 children)
damage: Store, pharmacy, and post office building destroyed by fire
notes: Day of mourning declared in Mykolaiv Oblast

label: Russian ballistic missiles — Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
damage: Warehouse fire in Darnytskyi district; explosions in surrounding Kyiv Oblast communities
notes: Air raid alert issued minutes before impact; Banderol munitions also reported moving toward Brovary/Kyiv

label: Ukrainian drones — Ozon warehouse & Novokuibyshevsk refinery, Samara region
damage: Fire across much of Ozon's 135,000 sq m Chapaevsk logistics complex; Novokuibyshevsk oil refinery also struck
casualties: Wider overnight wave killed 6 across Russia (incl. Yeysk port, Belgorod)
notes: First Ukrainian strike on Ozon (Russia's #2 online retailer), following weeks of strikes on Wildberries

label: Russian guided bombs — Izium (2–4 injured)
damage: ~20 houses, vehicles and power lines damaged in Izium's northern district and Verkhnie Selyshche neighborhood
notes: Latest in a string of guided-bomb strikes on the city through August (5 injured Aug 16)

label: Jet-powered Russian drone — Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district (8 injured)
damage: Fires across two houses and an outbuilding (~250 sq m); nearby homes and a vehicle damaged

label: Ukrainian drones — Ozon logistics center, Orenburg (~1,000km from border)
damage: Fire at Ozon warehouse; extent unclear, unconfirmed by Ukraine's military
notes: Second reported strike on Ozon facilities in 24 hours, following the Aug 22 Samara region strike

label: Independence Day barrage — Kharkiv Oblast (5 killed, 17 injured)
damage: Railway infrastructure struck in the Lozova community; homes damaged region-wide
notes: Part of a nationwide barrage on Ukraine's Independence Day: 2 Oniks, 6 Kh-31P/Kh-59 missiles, 143 drones; 8 killed, 43 injured nationwide

label: Russian Geran-5 drone — residential building, central Chernihiv (20 injured)
damage: 9-story residential building hit; fire on ground floor
notes: Third wave of strikes on Chernihiv that day; struck at midday on Independence Day

label: Ukrainian drones — Kombinat Kamenskiy rocket-fuel plant, Rostov Oblast
damage: Fire at rocket-fuel plant producing propellant for Uragan/Smerch/Tornado-S MLRS; also hit Ozon warehouses (Dagestan, Stavropol, Adygea; shares -12%), a MiG-29 near Dolotinka, 4 radar systems, a SOBR base in occupied Strilkove, and 2 shadow-fleet vessels
casualties: Debris from an intercepted drone reportedly killed 2 children, injured 9 at a Krasnodar childcare center, per Russian officials
notes: 66 targets struck overnight per commander Robert 'Madyar' Brovdi

label: Russian Geran-3 drones — Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district (4 injured)
damage: Six residential houses and five vehicles damaged
notes: Part of a nationwide barrage: 1 Iskander-M, 1 Kh-31P, 150 strike UAVs across 10 oblasts

label: Russian strike — Zaporizhzhia industrial facility
damage: Industrial facility building and vehicles caught fire
notes: Followed an earlier Aug 25 afternoon drone attack on Zaporizhzhia that injured 7 and burned ~10 vehicles

label: Ukrainian drones — logistics depot, occupied Melitopol
damage: Consignment of generators and military equipment destroyed inside a former Epicentr hardware store used as a Russian logistics hub
notes: Russian state TV inadvertently exposed the generator delivery, providing targeting intelligence

label: Ukrainian drones — Lukoil NORSI refinery, Kstovo (Nizhny Novgorod Oblast)
damage: Fire at Russia's 4th-largest oil refinery (15-17M tonnes/year capacity, 2nd-largest gasoline producer), ~800km from the Ukrainian border
notes: Part of a 16-target overnight strike on Russian oil, logistics, and military infrastructure per Zelensky; NORSI hit repeatedly in 2026 (Apr 5, May 20, Jun 24, Jul 2)

label: Ukrainian drones — Wildberries logistics center, Kotovsk (Tambov Oblast)
damage: ~100,000 sq m of the warehouse destroyed by fire (equivalent to 14 football pitches); second strike on the facility since July
casualties: 3 killed across Russia in broader overnight campaign (Lipetsk and Belgorod oblasts)
notes: Part of Zelensky's stated 16-target overnight campaign against Russian oil, logistics, and military infrastructure

label: Russian guided bomb — Kherson combined heat and power plant
damage: City's main civilian heating plant seriously damaged; full assessment pending
notes: Plant struck dozens of times through 2026; per Naftogaz Group statement

label: Russian nationwide barrage — 9 cities incl. Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia
damage: Residential blocks, a school and a medical facility hit in four Kyiv districts; distribution centers, port and grain infrastructure in Odesa; industrial site in Zaporizhzhia
casualties: 2 killed (78-year-old woman in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, 1 in Kharkiv Oblast), 14+ wounded
platform: Iskander-M/KN-23 ballistic missiles, Oniks, S8000 Banderol cruise missiles, Shahed-type drones
notes: Russian MoD called it a 'massive' strike on military-related targets; Ukrainian officials said civilian infrastructure across 9 cities was hit

label: Russian strike — Zaporizhzhia and surrounding districts
damage: Civilian infrastructure damaged across the city and surrounding districts
notes: Part of the nationwide Aug. 27 barrage on 9 Ukrainian cities

label: Russian jet-powered drone — Epicentr shopping mall, Kharkiv
damage: Partial structural damage to the mall; fire covering 300+ sq m
notes: Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district; preliminary data indicates a Geran-4 'Seeker' drone

label: Ukrainian cruise missiles — Russian army command posts, occupied Donetsk
damage: Struck an underground parking area of an unfinished residential complex and the former UkrStateNDIplastmas research institute buildings
notes: OSINT analysts (Exilenova+) assess one site may have hosted a command post of Russia's 51st Guards Combined Arms Army; strike began Aug. 26, confirmed overnight into Aug. 27
